summary: The root عيل (Eyl) primarily signifies poverty and want. It also describes something being unattainable or not knowing where to seek something lost.
lane: 1 عَالَ ذ , aor. يَعِيلُ , inf. n. عَيْلَةٌ (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K) [afterwards said in the K to be the subst. from this verb] and عُيُولٌ (S, O, K) and عِيُولٌ (TA) and عَيْلٌ and مَعِيلٌ ; (K;) and عال , aor. يَعُولُ ; (Ks, TA in art. عول ;) and ; (K in that art.;) He was, or became, poor, (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K,) and in want. (S, O.) So in the saying مَا لَهُ مَالَ وَعَالَ , [of which see another explanation in art. عول ,] a form of imprecation. (TA.) It is said in a trad., مَا عَالَ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَلَا يَعِيلُ i. e. [ One following the right course ] has not become poor [ nor will he become poor ]. (TA.) And one says, لَا يَعِيلُ أَحَدٌ عَلَى القَصْدِ [and لَا يَقُولُ , expl. in art. عول ], (Yoo, TA.) -b2- See also 4. -A2- عَالَنِى , (S, O, K,) aor. as above, (S, O,) inf. n. عَيْلٌ and مَعِيلٌ , It (a thing) was, or became, wanted by me, and unattainable to me: (S, O, K:) mentioned by El-Ahmar. (S, O.) -b2- And عال الضَّالَّةَ , (S, O, K,) aor. as above, inf. n. عَيْلٌ and عَيَلَانٌ , (S, O,) He knew not where to seek the stray beast. (S, O, K.) -A3- عال , (S, O,) or عال فِى مَشْيِهِ , (K,) aor. as above, inf. n. عَيْلٌ , (S, O,) said of a horse, (S, O, TA,) and of a man, (S, TA,) He inclined from side to side in his gait, (S, O, K,) and (when said of a man, S) was proud, haughty, or self-conceited, therein: (S, K:) the doing so in a horse is commended, as indicative of his generousness: (TA:) and signifies the same, (O, K,) said of a man. (O.) -b2- And عال فِى الأَرْضِ , (O, K,) aor. as above, (O,) inf. n. عَيْلٌ and عُيُول and عُيُولٌ , thus in the K, i. e. with damm and fet-h, but in the M [ عُيُولٌ and عِيُولٌ , i. e.] with damm and kesr, [of the like whereof there are many instances, one of them in the first sentence above,] (TA,) He (a man, O) went, or went away, (O, K,) and round about, (K, TA, but not in the CK) in the land; (O, K;) or journeyed therein seeking sustenance, or for the purpose of traffic; syn. ضَرَبَ فِيهَا : so says IAmb. (O.) -b3- عال المِيزَانُ , aor. يَعِيلُ and يَعُولُ , inf. n. عَيْلٌ and عَوْلٌ : see art. عول .

headwords.def: aor. يَعِيلُ, inf. n. عَيْلَةٌ (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K) [afterwards said in the K to be the subst. from this verb] and عُيُولٌ (S, O, K) and عِيُولٌ (TA) and عَيْلٌ and مَعِيلٌ; (K;) and عال, aor. يَعُولُ; (Ks, TA in art. عول;) and; (K in that art.;) He was, or became, poor, (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K,) and in want. (S, O.) So in the saying مَا لَهُ مَالَ وَعَالَ, [of which see another explanation in art. عول,] a form of imprecation.

as intrans.: see 4; and see also 1 in art. عول, fourth sentence. عيّل عيَالَهُ He neglected his family, or household: (TA, and K in art. عول:) or تَعْيِيلٌ signifies the feeding badly. (S, O.) See also 2 in art. عول, second sentence. And see 1 in that art., first sentence. عيّل فَرَسَهُ He (a man) left his horse alone, or by himself, to pasture where he would, without a pastor, in the desert. (S, O.)

He (a man) had a family, or household; so accord. to Akh: or he had a numerous family or household; (S, O, TA;) as also أَعْيَلَ, and, and. (TA.) [See also 1 in art. عول, fourth sentence.] And see the first sentence of the present art. Also, said of a wolf, (O, K,) and of a lion, and of a leopard, (K,) He sought, or sought after, (O, K,) a thing, (O,) or prey. (K.) See also 4 in art. عول, last sentence.
تَعَيَّلَ see 1, latter half.
: see عَيْلَةٌ: and see also عَائِلٌ.

The propounding of one's narration, and talk, to him who does not desire it and whom it does not concern; (O, K;) [and so, app.,; for it is said that] this is what is meant in the saying of the Prophet, إِنَّ مِنَ القَوْلِ عَيَلًا, or, as some relate it, عِيَالًا: [whence it seems that both readings mean Verily of what is said is the propounding of one's narration, &c.:] so says Saasa'ah. (O.)
: see the next paragraph. [ And see عَائِلٌ, of which it is a pl.] See also art. عول.

[mentioned above as an inf. n., and also said in the K to be a subst.,] Poverty, (S, O, K,) and want; thus in the Kur ix. 28; as also; (S, O;) and, and thus accord. to one reading in the Kur ix. 28; and accord. to IAar,, with kesr, is syn. with عَيْلَةٌ. (TA.) It is also a pl. [or rather a quasi-pl. n.] of عَائِلٌ q. v. (S, TA.) طَالَ عَيْلَتِى إِيَّاكَ means Long has continued my feeding, nourishing, or sustaining, thee. (O, K. [But this app. belongs to art.
A woman that weeps [or wails ] for the dead. (AA, O. [But this also app. belongs to art. عول.]) Also a pl. of عَائِلٌ [q. v.]. (S, O, K.)
The male hyena. (S, O, K.)
a pl. of which the sing is عَيِّلٌ and of which the pl. is عَيَائِلُ, this last being a pl. pl.: see art. عول. See also عَيَلٌ, above.
The fodder, or provender, of a بِرْ َوْن [or hackney]; as also. (Fr, O, K.)

That inclines from side to side in gait, and is proud, haughty, or self-conceited, therein: (S, O, TA;) as also, of which عَيْلَةٌ is a pl. [or rather a quasi-pl. n.]: (IAar, TA:) the former applied to a horse, (S, TA,) and to a lion: (S, O, TA:) and so with ة applied to a woman. (K, TA.) Respecting the saying of Hokeym Ibn-Mo'eiyeh Er-Raba'ee, cited by Sb, فِيهَا عَيَايِيلُ أُسُودٍ وَنُمُرْ Ibn-Es-Seeráfee says, it is as though he said فيها مُتَبَخْتِرَاتُ &c. [i. e.

Poor, (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K,) and needy, or in want; (S, O;) occurring in the Kur xciii. 8; (TA;) as also, (TA,) and: (Ibn-El-Kelbee, TA:) pl. of the first عَالَةٌ, (Mgh, O, Msb, K,) [originally] of the measure فَعَلَةٌ, like كَفَرَةٌ pl. of كَافِرٌ, (Msb,) and عُيَّلٌ (K) and عَيْلَى (S, O, K) and [quasi-pl. ns.] (S, TA) and. (IAar, TA.) See also عَيَّالٌ.
: see عَيْلَةٌ.
originally of the measure فَيْعِلٌ: (ISd, TA in art. عول:) see عِيَالٌ, in two places, in art. عول. See also عَائِلٌ. And see مُعِيلٌ: and عَيَّالٌ.

: see عَائِلٌ. Also A man having a family, or household; and so: (TA:) or having a numerous family or household; and in like manner, with ة, applied to a woman. (S, O, TA.) [See also art. عول.] Also, applied to a wolf, a lion, and a leopard, Seeking, or seeking after, prey; (K, TA;) and so. (TA.)
: see مُعِيلٌ in this art., and also in art. عول.
: see art. عول.
: see عِيَالَةٌ.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
